v1_vs_v21.summary: v2.1 keeps v2's +20pp entry-recall win AND matches v1's content preservation (substantive loss identical: 89 tokens). Page-level sanity (e.g. page 14) shows v2.1 closely tracks source token counts; v1 was inflated by content duplication.

notes: Coverage screen: yogamalawa Stage-3 v2.1 against source OCR.
98.5% per-token coverage; 1.54% substantive Sinhala loss matches v1.
Lost substantive tokens are predominantly indication-phrase terminals (e.g. 'කුෂ්ටයට.', 'අතීසාරයට.') with no successor entry to attach to.

Entry recall: 133/231 = 57.6% (v1 was 37.2%); the still-missing 98 verses largely sit on pages where rows interleave entry numbers with other content and the max_seen+1..+5 embedded window doesn't cover them (some pages have entry-number gaps > 5).
Duplication unchanged at 191 tokens — surfaces 9 distinct entry numbers appearing more than once; downstream tools should deduplicate by 'අංකය'.
